title: unified-rollouts-enhance-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback
author: Nora Kim
description:
Motivation: Improve safety and observability of unified rollouts by tightening automated rollback rules, adding a quarantine/probing stage for shadow traffic, and extending canary/A-B knobs for phased rollouts. This PR consolidates multiple follow-ups from previous rollout work: it reduces false positives on metric-driven rollbacks, enables a short quarantine window for probing new model variants under shadow traffic before they affect canary weights, and exposes additional configuration for A/B experiments (traffic split by origin and metric-level thresholds).

Summary of changes: 1) Autorollback engine: add composite-metric quorum logic to avoid single-metric flip triggers; support weighted thresholding and hysteresis to prevent rapid oscillation. 2) Quarantine/probing stage: introduce a lightweight probing pipeline for shadowed variants that runs a targeted set of probe prompts and synthetic users, with configurable duration and success criteria; only after passing quarantine does a variant enter canary. 3) Canary/A-B controls: add route-level A/B split overrides, origin-based routing rules, and per-variant rollout windows. 4) Observability: new telemetry for quarantine pass/fail, per-variant probe results, decision audit trail, and dashboard panels. 5) Tests and e2e: unit tests for quorum logic, integration tests for quarantine->canary progression, and an e2e scenario that simulates a metric regression and verifies rollback.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in Linear (ENG-4921). - [x] Unit tests for autorollback logic. - [x] Integration tests for quarantine stage. - [x] Dashboards added (grafana panel ids included in docs). - [x] Backwards compatible: existing rollout specs remain valid; new fields are optional.

Backward compatibility and migration notes: rollout spec schema extended with optional fields: quarantine.duration_seconds, quarantine.probe_set, autorollback.quorum.window_seconds, autorollback.quorum.required_metrics. Existing rollout configs are unaffected. We will increment the rollout API minor version but leave previous runtimes compatible.

Rollout plan: merge to main, deploy rollout-controller behind a feature flag (rollout.v2.quarantine=true) for a 72h canary in staging, enable in production for a small set of customers with manual approval. Monitor new metrics and have an immediate revert plan (automated fallback to previous model variant) if quarantine failures spike.

Why this matters: Recent incidents showed oscillating rollbacks cause flapping and degraded overall system reliability; quarantine probes reduce surface area of unstable models reaching canaries, and quorum logic reduces overreaction to transient metric noise.
commits: feat(rollouts): add quarantine/probing stage and probe runner
feat(autorollback): composite-metric quorum and hysteresis for decision stability
feat(api): extend rollout spec with quarantine and quorum fields
feat(observability): emit probe results, decision audit events, dashboards
test(rollouts): unit and integration tests for quarantine and quorum logic
chore(docs): rollout spec examples and migration notes
review_thread: Diego Martinez: Overall this looks good. Two requests: (1) clarify the default quorum window and rationale in the doc, (2) add a short-circuit for low-traffic variants so probes don't block small experiments.
Author (Nora Kim): Added explanation in docs and implemented short-circuit + unit tests to skip quarantine for variants with <1000 requests/day (configurable).
Priya Shah: The telemetry looks sufficient but please ensure probe results do not include user PII; add explicit sanitization in probe runner.
Author: Probe runner updated to hash identifiers and we added a privacy note in telemetry MD. Updated tests accordingly.
Ethan Liu: Integration test timing flakes on CI. Can you reduce timeouts and add a retry for the probe runner start?
Author: Reduced time windows in test and added a startup retry; CI run passed.
Priya Shah: approving after last changes
release_notes: Enhancements to unified rollouts: quarantine/probing stage for shadow traffic, composite-metric quorum-based autorollback to reduce flapping, new A/B and origin-based routing controls, and observability for probe results and decision audit trail. Backwards compatible; new rollout spec fields optional.
notes: Deploy behind feature flag rollout.v2.quarantine. Monitor rollout.quarantine.pass_rate and autorollback.decision_rate for first 72h. If notice increased quarantine failures, revert feature flag and investigate probe failures.
